## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Track D (design rules and UI component setup), wave D2. This is audit backlog UX-03 of the Nov 2026 product UX audit (an audit id, not an MDV key).

Persona and route: /consult/:id, /consult/:id/medicines, /consult/:id/problems, /nurse/:id, /patients/:id and the desk record /patients/directory/:id · doctor, nurse, receptionist (desk variant only) · 1440, 1024 and 768.
Findings and reviewers: F-02, F-10, F-19 · reviewers A-01, B-01, B-03, B-08, C-02. Part 3 of 3 of audit backlog UX-03 (parts 1 and 2 built the components).
Rationale: While the doctor prescribes, nothing on screen names the patient or the allergy: the banner scrolls away on a page up to 5,350 px tall and the prescription table starts near 4,200 px. NISTIR 7804-1 asks that patient identification stay displayed in the same place regardless of scrolling. The floating sign bar hides fields and focus. All three reviewers found this independently; it is one of three system changes allowed before the pilot.
Proposed UX behaviour: The consultation, its medicines and problems sub-pages and nurse intake show PatientBanner in the strip variant, pinned under the top bar while the page scrolls: name, age and sex, MRN, date of birth, the allergy in words, consent. The patient record uses the full variant and the desk record the desk variant, so the three old headers are gone (features/encounters IdentityBanner, the primitive IdentityBanner and the PatientRecord header card are removed). The Review and sign bar becomes the StickyActionBar footer that reserves its space. Nothing focusable is ever under pinned chrome; pinned chrome takes at most 30 % of the viewport height; at 400 % zoom the strip and footer un-pin. The Add medicine dialog and the sign dialog keep repeating the patient, as today. No rule, wording or field changes.
Prototype and blueprint reference: docs/product-ux-audit/concepts/medvya-workspace-concept.html, doctor view, audit notes 2 and 7; docs/product-ux-audit/concepts/screenshots/doctor-1440.png, doctor-1024.png, doctor-768.png; blueprint sections 8 and 10.
Components and tokens affected: Uses PatientBanner, StickyActionBar and SaveStatus. Removes encounters/IdentityBanner and the primitive IdentityBanner. No token change.
Front end and back end split: Front end only. No API change.
Prerequisites and blocked by: Blocked by the PatientBanner ticket and the StickyActionBar and SaveStatus ticket (wave D1b). File ownership in wave D2: this ticket owns ConsultStudio.tsx, ConsultPage.tsx and the nurse-intake page until it merges; the consultation layout ticket starts after it.
Clinical sign-off: Required before merge: questions 3 and 4 of docs/product-ux-audit/11-pilot-doctor-validation-plan.md (pilot doctor and nurse), recorded on the issue with a date. Safe acceptance criterion 2 of that plan applies: whose record is this and what is she allergic to, answered without scrolling, three times out of three.
Effort and regression risk: M · Medium: 13 test files touch the consultation. Controlled by keeping J2 and J3 green and changing no controller.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) The consultation layout pass (next ticket in this wave). (2) The queue button in the strip (queue rail ticket). (3) Nurse intake on a phone: blocked until one group shows per screen (phone rule ticket). (4) Any change to allergy rules or wording.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given an open consultation for a patient with a recorded penicillin allergy at 1440 by 900, 1024 by 768 and 768 by 1024, when the page is scrolled to the prescription, then the patient's name and the words Allergy: Penicillin are inside the viewport
- [ ] **AC2.** Given the medicines and problems sub-pages and nurse intake at 1024 touch, when each is scrolled to its last field, then the strip is still visible and names the same patient
- [ ] **AC3.** Given the browser test for the strip, when the pinning is removed from the component, then the test fails (mutation check, shown in the pull request)
- [ ] **AC4.** Given the consultation, when every control is reached with Tab, then each focused element is fully visible and none is under the strip or the footer
- [ ] **AC5.** Given the codebase, when it is searched, then encounters IdentityBanner and the primitive IdentityBanner are gone and the chart and the consultation show the allergy with the same look
- [ ] **AC6.** Given a receptionist on the desk record, when the header renders, then it shows no allergy, diagnosis, medicine or vitals, and the server's refusal of clinical routes for that role is unchanged
- [ ] **AC7.** Given 400 % zoom, when the page scrolls, then strip and footer scroll with it; and in Arabic the strip mirrors and axe finds no violation in either language
- [ ] **AC8.** Given 1024 by 768, when top bar, strip, section anchors and footer are measured, then together they take at most 30 % of the height

- Playwright (tests/e2e/nurse-intake.spec.ts and J3 step 5): the strip stays on nurse intake at 1024 touch.
- tests/e2e/consult-studio.spec.ts and tablet.spec.ts updated; en and ar; axe clean.
